en-US.description: An independent agent workspace and full harness for coding, research, and other project work.
en-US.longDescription: Varin is an independent agent workspace and full harness for coding, research, and other project work, centered on local and desktop experiences. It bundles the Pi runtime: the model and provider stack, session tree, package manager, and extension model remain Pi-owned, while Varin owns the surrounding tool environment, working state, recovery, retrieval, context policy, task governance, and workbench surfaces. Varin ships two first-party working shapes: an Agent Workspace centered on sessions, tasks, and context, and an IDE Workbench centered on editors, search, Git, diagnostics, and debugging with the agent as a dockable panel.
en-US.releaseNotes:
Varin 0.9.36 focuses on model compatibility, reliable response handling, storage upgrades, and native desktop localization.
Model compatibility and reliability
- Fixed official OpenAI API requests being rejected with HTTP 400 for tools such as document_read. Tool parameters are now presented as compatible object schemas while the original tool owner retains full argument validation.
- Improved Responses handling for truncated output, refusals, and failures, preserving usage reported at the end of a response. Incomplete Bedrock tool blocks are no longer accepted as executable calls.
- Removed duplicate thinking text from Chat-compatible reasoning aliases, preserved Google-compatible tool signatures for valid continuation, and improved Google, Mistral, and Pi protocol handling.
- Preserved non-secret URL query parameters across model discovery and operation paths. Fixed credential/header precedence and Bedrock signing-region selection. OAuth connections now follow the installed channel type's declared issuers, including explicitly configured proxy endpoints.
- Kept the single-choice Chat default compatible with omitted or nullable n, without losing explicit zero-valued sampling settings.
Varin entry and navigation
- Renamed the Bot mode to Varin and used the Varin brand mark in the mode selector. New configurations now start in Varin; existing mode selections are preserved.
- The sidebar Settings entry opens ordinary application settings, retaining the last visited page and the button-origin opening animation.
Storage and desktop
- Upgraded TriviumDB to 0.9.0. Recoverable legacy 0.8 WAL data is checkpointed automatically before opening with the new engine, preserving existing records without requiring a manual rebuild.
- Fixed observation-store corruption classification to use structured native error codes across the private storage process.
- Fixed desktop packaging to retain only the target-platform native addon for both TriviumDB generations, including the legacy upgrade helper, correcting Linux AppImage validation failures.
- Added native-shell translations for all 10 application languages: menus, right-click menus, tray text, confirmation dialogs, file-dialog titles/buttons, and computer-control overlays. Language changes synchronize across windows and persist across restarts.
- Updated and consolidated documentation to match the current implementation.
- Fixed Docker kernel builds to honor the requested target platform and CPU architecture, including ARM64, and export artifacts under the matching build-cache identity.

zh-CN.description: 面向编程与科研的独立 Agent 工作台与完整 Harness。
zh-CN.longDescription: Varin 是一个独立的 Agent 工作台与完整 Harness，面向编程、科研和其他项目工作，以本地和桌面体验为中心。它内置 Pi 运行时；模型与提供商栈、会话树、包管理器和扩展模型仍由 Pi 提供，而 Varin 负责周围的工具环境、工作状态、恢复、检索、上下文策略、任务治理和工作台界面。Varin 自带两套官方工作形态：以会话、任务和上下文为中心的 Agent Workspace，以及以编辑器、搜索、Git、诊断和调试为中心、把智能体作为可停靠面板的 IDE Workbench。
zh-CN.name: Varin
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Varin 0.9.36 重点修复模型兼容性、流式响应与用量处理，升级存储引擎，并补齐桌面原生界面的多语言支持。
模型兼容与请求可靠性
- 修复调用 OpenAI 官方 API 时，document_read 等工具的参数 schema 导致 HTTP 400 的问题。发送给模型的是兼容的对象 schema，完整参数校验仍由原工具负责。
- 改善 Responses 对截断输出、拒绝与失败的处理，保留响应尾部上报的用量；Bedrock 未闭合的工具块不会再成为可执行调用。
- 消除 Chat 兼容渠道重复展示思考内容的问题，保留 Google 兼容工具签名用于有效的后续请求，并完善 Google、Mistral、Pi 的协议处理。
- 模型发现与各操作路径保留非敏感 URL 查询参数，修正凭据与请求头的优先级、Bedrock 签名区域选择。OAuth 连接按已安装渠道声明的认证来源准入，支持显式配置的代理端点。
- 保留 Chat 的单回答默认行为：n 可省略或为 null，显式设置为零的采样参数也会保留。
Varin 入口与导航
- 将「Varin bot」模式更名为「Varin」，模式选择器使用品牌 Logo。新配置默认进入 Varin，已有用户保留所选模式。
- 侧栏底部改为「设置」，打开通用设置，保留上次浏览的设置页和从按钮位置展开的动画。
存储与桌面体验
- TriviumDB 升级到 0.9.0。可恢复的旧版 0.8 WAL 会在打开前自动完成检查点转换，保留已有记录，无需手动重建。
- 工作区观察存储改用原生结构化错误码识别损坏，错误分类能够穿过私有存储进程正确传递。
- 修复桌面打包时旧版 TDB 升级助手混入其他平台原生库的问题，两代引擎均只保留目标平台文件，解决 Linux AppImage 架构校验失败。
- Electron 自有原生文案补齐现有 10 种语言，覆盖菜单、右键菜单、托盘、确认框、文件对话框标题与按钮、电脑控制条；切换语言后多窗口同步，重启后保留。
- 整理并更新文档，使其与当前实现一致。
- 修复 Docker 内核构建忽略目标平台与 CPU 架构的问题，正确处理 ARM64 等目标，并按实际目标导出构建缓存产物。
